title: IDW Comics Inserts: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Some call me a thief. I prefer to think of myself as a discreet borrower." —Dack Fayden, Planeswalker
Imbued in the Ancient Fang were spells far darker than any Dack Fayden would cast.
Fayden didn't know if the giant had created the spehere's magic—only that he had to escape it to find Sifa.
"Youth is wasted on the young. So I help myself to some of it from time to time." —Sifa Grent
"You learn a lot in no time when you're about to get your neck snapped." —Dack Fayden
The draconic demon loomed over Dack, and he suddenly sensed he wasn't the only Planeswalker that Malfegor had encountered.
"All of Ravnica's looking for you, Dack, from the Wojek on down." —Maytov
"There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."
"Perhaps planning should become a higher priority for me." —Dack Fayden
